**sdd/issue-246-c3/design**

## Design — issue-246-c3 plainfiles memory backend (second MEMORY_BACKEND inhabitant)

**What**: Technical design for the `plainfiles` backend. Written to openspec/changes/issue-246-c3/design.md (English, ADR-0009, house format mirroring issue-229-c4/design.md). Honors the Q1-Q3 ruling (obs #578).

**Where**: New/changed prod files — brain/scripts/memory/backends/plainfiles.mjs (new), brain/scripts/memory/lib/unsupported-op.mjs (new), format.mjs (+nowUtcSeconds), engram.mjs (+save/search refusal stubs), cli.mjs (VALID_OPS +save/search, save arg-parse), i18n/en.mjs+es.mjs.

### Decisions
1. **Module shape** — all ops async + seam-injected like engram.mjs. Exports: save(title,content,{type,project,scope,topic})→{id,file,written}; search(query,{root,mode})→{matches}; share({root})→{indexCount}=rebuildIndex only; pull({root})→{indexCount}=git pull+rebuildIndex; setup({root})=mkdir records/ + rebuildIndex self-check (NO symlink/merge-driver — engram-only). index/featureCheckpoint/featureResume → throw via shared unsupportedOp helper.
2. **save provenance MEASURED, never flagged (Q2)** — actor←getBranch(root) (reused engram.mjs#_getGitBranch); actorKind←constant 'agent' (structural: cli save door is the agent path per Q1; NOT caller-supplied = spoof-resistant); ts←nowUtcSeconds() (NEW pure helper in format.mjs: getNow().toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/,'Z') — the exact C2a seconds rule from engram-export.mjs:31, matches format.mjs:27 UTC_TS_RE; NOT new Date()). getHostname folded into non-hashed source field. No --actor/--actor-kind/--ts flag. Rationale: records/ is the durable governance log; a flag would forge authorship (same spoof class L5 actor-check prevents). Scan-then-write: buildRecord → scanTextForSecrets over candidate line BEFORE appendRecord (mirrors dualWriteRecords order) → appendRecord + rebuildIndex.
3. **search zero-binary (D2)** — readRecordObservations + Node substring/regex filter over content/title/type. rg used only if `which rg` succeeds (idempotent to Node results); never in package.json/install-tools.sh. _which/_rg seams.
4. **share/pull minimal (Q3)** — WHY manifest-dirty-discard does NOT apply: pullMemory() discards manifest churn because manifest is engram MATERIALIZATION (regenerable, rewritten by `engram sync --export`). plainfiles NEVER materializes; records/*.jsonl are committed source-of-truth, git is only writer. Dirty tree = real work, never churn → delegate to git + report honestly, NEVER auto-discard (would be data loss). rebuildIndex only after clean pull.
5. **Q1 asymmetry + shared unsupportedOp** — lib/unsupported-op.mjs: `async unsupportedOp(op, backend, {key, params})` throws i18n error; cli catch prints+exits 1. engram.save/search → memory.save.engramUnsupported (point to native mem_save/mem_search). plainfiles index/featureCheckpoint/featureResume → memory.op.unsupported. engram.search stub is a ~4-line consistency add (flagged for tasks; ruling names only save).
6. **Round-trip test (CP-C3, D6)** — reuses C4 injection. engram→plainfiles: dualWriteRecords(tmpRoot,{_readObservations:fixture}) then plainfiles.search asserts content. plainfiles→engram: plainfiles.save(pinned seams) then importMemory({_engramSave:captureCalls}). Record-level equality (computeRecordId===id). N records = all 7 RECORD_TYPES + supersedes chain. No live engram/git; *.test.mjs + .memory/** budget-excluded.
7. **cli wiring** — VALID_OPS +save/search; save special-cased (like reindex/migrate-v1) parsing title/content positionals + --type/--project/--scope/--topic; search forwards positional. en+es i18n.

### Resolved open questions
Q1 ASYMMETRIC (engram gets refusal stubs, not real save/search). Q2 MIRROR+MEASURED (derivers documented). Q3 MINIMAL pull (manifest-discard rationale written).

### Budget
~280-345 counted lines (plainfiles.mjs ~190-240 + unsupported-op ~12 + nowUtcSeconds ~6 + engram stubs ~10 + cli ~40-50 + i18n ~20-28). ≤400 single slice, no size:exception, no C3a/C3b split. Fallback split documented, not planned.

**Learned**: C2a canonical ts helper is the `.replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/,'Z')` rule (engram-export.mjs:31 toUtcSeconds); new nowUtcSeconds() belongs in format.mjs (pure-only contract, owns UTC_TS_RE). actor-check.mjs L5 operates on PR label events, NOT record.actor — the "feeds actor-check" ruling is about governance-log integrity principle, not direct field consumption. cli.mjs generic dispatch mis-passes flags → save needs a special-case parser.
